thread:
Evan (PM): quick design check: new compact invite drawer + an "Activity" quick-jump in roles list. figma: https://figma.redwood/snap/invite-compact 

Evan (PM): two Qs: 1) For orgs with enforced SSO, remove the email input entirely or keep disabled with tooltip? 2) For Activity jump, what's the best keyboard + SR pattern?

Rina (Designer): remove the input for sso_enforced orgs. replace with a small info card: "Invites managed by your organization's SSO" + primary CTA "Copy join link" and a tertiary "Manage SSO". keep a tiny TTL hint.

Rina (Designer): Activity control: make it a real button next to role name (icon on desktop, full label on mobile). it should trigger scroll-to-audit and be focusable in the role tab order.

Sam (Frontend): ok on removing input when org.flags.sso_required==true. implementation notes: render a role=region aria-label="Invite method" card and announce change with aria-live="polite". for jump: use stable anchor ids (audit-role-<id>), then:
```
const target = document.getElementById(`audit-role-${id}`);
if (target) { target.setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'}); target.focus(); }
```
Fallback: if audit not loaded, open audit page in new tab and include role_id query param.

Aria (A11y): a11y checklist: 
- announce the replacement card with aria-live polite and role=region.
- ensure CTA has aria-describedby explaining who can use the join link.
- Activity button must be second focusable item after role name; add aria-controls to point to audit list.
- after focusing anchor, remove tabindex when focus leaves (avoid polluting tab order).
- check contrast on the SSO card text >= 4.5:1.

infra-bot: telemetry: emit invite.method (email|link|idp), invite.link.copied, audit.jump.source=roles_list and include role_id dimension.

Evan (PM): action items: Rina -> update comps removing email input; Sam -> aria-live announce + scroll/focus fallback; Aria -> final a11y checklist and SR test cases. i'll create tickets. thanks! :white_check_mark:
